question: Which of the following is the wild habitat of pygmy hogs?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Manas National Park.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The current range of **pygmy hog** is present only in the **reserve forest belts of the Manas Wildlife Sanctuary** and the **Barnadi Wildlife Sanctuary in northwestern Assam, India. **
 
• The pygmy hog is the only member of its** genus, Porcula**, and there may be as few as** 200 individuals remaining in the wild.**
 
• The pygmy hog is a suid domestic to alluvial grasslands in the **foothills of the Himalayas at heights of up to 300 m (980 ft). **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kanha Tiger Reserve park **has a remarkable population of the** Royal Bengal tiger, Indian leopards, the sloth bear, barasingha and Indian wild dog.​ **
 
• The** royal Bengal tiger** is popular in **Jim Corbett National Park.**
 
• **Rajaji National national park**, mainly popular for its **elephant population**.
